description: The shared state carried by STATE_SNAPSHOT and stored with the thread. Top-level keys are replaced and not deep-merged, so each one belongs to a single writer: plan to the plan tools, artifacts to the UI tools, subagent_pending to the subagent tools. `subagent_pending.context_id` is the conversation the waiting task belongs to: an answer sent without it opens a new conversation, and the agent refuses it.

artifacts.title: knowledge: how does Go do typing?

subagent_pending.question: Which language are you asking about: Go, Python or Rust?
